snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Knockout Expansion Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor ‘Knockout’ Expansion DLC brings a brand-new class, a brutal new biome, a fresh mission type, and a lethal bundle of weapons to bolster ongoing Hoxxes operations. Watch the Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor Knockout Expansion Reveal Trailer here.

Wishlist now:
